import copy,csv,json,subprocess
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import record,check
from benchmark_tools.run_membership_hillclimb import write_json
from benchmark_tools.report_hillclimb import ENDPOINTS,screen
repo=Path.cwd();base=repo/"benchmark_tools/results"
parent_path=base/"hillclimb_comparison_readback_v10_20261013/summary.json"
parent=json.loads(parent_path.read_text());methods=copy.deepcopy(parent["methods"])
admit_path=repo/"benchmarks/results/component_recovery_admission_r1_v1_20261013/report.json"
admitted=json.loads(admit_path.read_text())
text=subprocess.check_output(["sacct","-j","24222","-X","--format=JobID,State,ExitCode,AllocCPUS","--parsable2"],text=True)
jobs=list(csv.DictReader(text.splitlines(),delimiter="|"))
if jobs!=[dict(JobID="24222",State="COMPLETED",ExitCode="0:0",AllocCPUS="1")] or admitted["status"]!="terminal_component_candidates_and_raw_scores_independently_verified": raise ValueError("Component recovery is not independently terminal")
for pin in admitted["checked"]: check(pin)
method=next(m for m in methods if m["key"]=="large_copy_components:components500")
previous=copy.deepcopy(next(c for c in method["cells"] if c["dataset"]=="QfO"))
method["cells"]=[c for c in method["cells"] if c["dataset"]!="QfO"]
cell={k:admitted[k] for k in ("method_key","dataset","scores","details","coverage","products","native_summary","component_counts","execution_kind")}
cell.update(status="independent_content_readback_verified",independent_readback=record(admit_path),recovery_schedulers=admitted["schedulers"],admission_scheduler=jobs[0],earlier_unadmitted_cell=previous,resources={"native_metrics":record(repo/"benchmarks/results/large_copy_components_r1_v2_20261013/QfO/components500/metrics.json"),"native_gnu_time":record(repo/"benchmarks/results/large_copy_components_r1_v2_20261013/QfO/components500/native.time.txt"),"scoring_recovery_gnu_time":record(repo/"benchmarks/results/component_scoring_recovery_r1_v1_20261013/recovery.time.txt"),"scope":"Retained cached-graph native inference and separate recovered scoring; shared host, not fresh full-pipeline timing."})
method["cells"].append(cell);method["scores"].update(admitted["scores"]);method["complete_eight_endpoints"]=set(method["scores"])==set(ENDPOINTS)
if not method["complete_eight_endpoints"]: raise ValueError("Component vector is missing an endpoint")
for old,new in zip(parent["methods"],methods):
 if old["key"]!=method["key"] and old!=new: raise ValueError("Unrelated method or numeric score changed")
control=next(m for m in methods if m["key"]=="copy_branch:control")
of=next(m for m in methods if m["key"]=="orthofinder_3_1_5_full")
screening=screen({"control":control["scores"],"components500":method["scores"]},"control")
out=base/"hillclimb_comparison_readback_v11_20261013"
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
with (out/"scores.tsv").open("x",newline="") as stream:
 writer=csv.writer(stream,delimiter="\t",lineterminator="\n");writer.writerow(["method",*ENDPOINTS,"complete_eight_endpoints"])
 for m in methods: writer.writerow([m["label"],*(m["scores"].get(k,"NA") for k in ENDPOINTS),set(m["scores"])==set(ENDPOINTS)])
rows=list(csv.DictReader((out/"scores.tsv").open(),delimiter="\t"))
if len(rows)!=len(methods): raise ValueError("Table row count changed")
for row,m in zip(rows,methods):
 for key in ENDPOINTS:
  if row[key]!="NA" if key not in m["scores"] else float(row[key])!=m["scores"][key]: raise ValueError("Displayed score differs from admitted vector")
obsolete=("QfO component scores remain unavailable while native inference runs.","The earlier QfO component native-running snapshot is superseded:","This status-only refresh preserves")
limits=[s for s in parent["limitations"] if not s.startswith(obsolete)]
limits+=["The QfO component vector is now independently admitted after clean native verification, exact separate candidate reconstruction and raw score readback. Both signal-11 parent attempts remain preserved; no successful inference was repeated.","The complete component vector fails the unchanged 0.005 development decline screen on GO. No default promotion, statistical equivalence or universal superiority is claimed."]
summary={"status":"component_eight_endpoint_vector_independently_admitted_no_default_promotion","generated_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"parent_readback":record(parent_path),"methods":methods,"round_screening":{**parent["round_screening"],"large_copy_components":screening},"score_table":record(out/"scores.tsv"),"component_independent_readback":record(admit_path),"limitations":limits,"defaults_promoted":False,"goal_completed":False}
write_json(out/"summary.json",summary)
deltas=screening["comparisons"]["components500"]["deltas_from_matched_control"]
write_json(base/"large_copy_components_terminal_decision_20261013.json",{"status":"complete_admitted_component_vector_rejected_for_default_advancement","comparison":record(out/"summary.json"),"independent_admission":record(admit_path),"screen":screening,"deltas_vs_orthofinder_full":{k:method["scores"][k]-of["scores"][k] for k in ENDPOINTS},"screen_failures":{k:v for k,v in deltas.items() if v<-.005},"precision_recall_and_eligible_relation_counts":admitted["details"],"native_pair_count_change":admitted["coverage"]["pairs"]-next(c for c in control["cells"] if c["dataset"]=="QfO")["coverage"]["pairs"],"next_action":"Diagnose retained functional scored-pair changes and confidence classes before choosing a label-independent HMM/candidate/tree hypothesis. Do not tune reference exclusions or relax the screening rule to hide this regression.","defaults_promoted":False,"goal_completed":False})
print(json.dumps({"methods":len(methods),"component_scores":method["scores"],"screen_failures":{k:v for k,v in deltas.items() if v<-.005}}))
